summary: Tested the expanded WorkHop catalog (200 gigs across 4 buckets + 50 verified leads with keywords) and the two new skill/keyword search features (freelancer jobs feed testID=search-input, employer leads testID=leads-search-input). All 49 backend pytest tests pass (100%). All 6 requested frontend flows pass (100%): (1) employer skill search — 'shopify' shows Ishita Singh (WordPress/Shopify Developer, 1 card), 'sketchup' shows Akash Patel (Architectural 3D Visualizer / SketchUp Modeler, 1 card); (2) leads-search-clear-btn restores all 50 cards; (3) leads-empty renders on garbage term; (4) employer ₹199 unlock (unlock-cta-btn → pay-confirm-btn → unlocked-badge) works and unblurs names/phones/portfolios; (5) freelancer jobs feed loads exactly 200 gigs — keyword search matches 'sketchup' (4), 'flutterflow' (4), 'gst' (4), 'hubspot' (4); (6) category chips still filter (Marketing shown), apply flow (apply-confirm-btn → apply-success-flash) works, and all 200 job cards render without crash after full scroll. Only console noise: known React 19 element.ref warning from @gorhom/bottom-sheet (non-blocking, per task note).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking React 19 warning: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19'. Emitted by bottom-sheet in /app/frontend/app/employer/index.tsx and /app/frontend/app/freelancer/jobs.tsx. Known upstream; safe to ignore per task note.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~600 lines with 5 feature domains (leads, freelancer, jobs, quota, plans). Consider splitting into routers before next feature. Not urgent.
employer/index.tsx and freelancer/jobs.tsx both duplicate the search+clear TextInput + empty state UI. Extract a shared <SearchBar /> to avoid drift when placeholder/styling changes.
SEED_JOBS/SEED_LEADS are loaded at import time from JSON — good for perf. keyword arrays are surfaced consistently in both /api/jobs and /api/leads/preview responses (verified in code).

React Native ScrollView (not FlatList) is used to render 200 job cards in freelancer/jobs.tsx. Verified 200 cards render without crash on 390x844 viewport, but consider switching to FlatList/FlashList with windowing before catalog grows further — currently OK.
seed_data_creation: Two verified TEST_JobsUI freelancers created via /api/freelancer/pay + aadhaar/verify during UI tests (aadhaar 432112348765) and used to test apply flow. Multiple TEST_ employer unlocks inserted through the unlock UI. All namespaced with TEST_ prefix and harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalog counts locked: 200 jobs (Creative 56, Tech 48, Marketing 48, Ops 48) and 50 leads (one per profession). All jobs and all leads have a `keywords` array; both freelancer search (search-input) and employer search (leads-search-input) match against title/skill/name/description/portfolio AND the keywords array (case-insensitive). Known matches used in tests: sketchup→Akash Patel, shopify→Ishita Singh, flutterflow/gst/hubspot each match ≥1 job. React 19 element.ref warning from @gorhom/bottom-sheet is expected and can be ignored. Container server clock reads Jul 2026.
